labReports.resultsSummary: Fasting Blood Sugar: 142 mg/dL (Ref: 70-99). HbA1c: 7.8% (Ref: <5.7%). Estimated Average Glucose: 177 mg/dL.

labReports.resultsSummary: Total Cholesterol: 215 mg/dL. Triglycerides: 185 mg/dL. Serum Creatinine: 0.95 mg/dL (Normal). eGFR: >90 mL/min.

doctorReports.recommendations: Step up Metformin to 500mg twice daily with meals. Continue lifestyle interventions. Repeat renal profile and urine microalbumin in 6 months.
